description: This file is a shell script for testing the standalone HTTP status behavior of the gitweb CGI interface. It contains setup commands, configuration modifications, and a series of tests verifying HTTP status codes, headers, and other behaviors related to snapshots, object IDs, modification times, and server load handling.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Checks for Perl modules HTTP::Date or Time::ParseDate and sets prerequisites for date parsing tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Executes a test expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to be run after a test completes for cleanup.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Waits briefly to ensure subsequent commands operate on fresh data.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Runs the gitweb CGI interface with specified parameters to simulate HTTP requests.
